items.summary: The domain Role Matrix row for 08.03 gave the Musician 👁️ Read-only while its own child matrix grants Full on 08.03.03 and Config on 08.03.04. Verified the max-roll-up convention independently across all 20 remaining parent/child cells — 08.01 (Full/Full/Read-only → Full), 08.02 (Full/Read-only/Full → Full), 08.04 (Read-only/Full/Full → Full), 08.05 (Full/Read-only/Full/Full → Full), and every Producer/Operator/Fan column — plus the three leaf children 08.06/08.07/08.08, whose Role Lens rows match the domain row exactly. The convention holds without exception; Musician@08.03 was the single drifted cell, and it was neither a max nor a min of its children. Corrected the domain row to ✅ Full and added an explanatory note in the table's blockquote — matching the existing Fan and Operator notes in voice — stating that every cell is the widest grant any child confers, that the Musician's Full at 08.03 comes from 08.03.03 alone, and that on 08.03.01/08.03.02 they remain Read-only and on 08.03.04 hold Config over their own declared playback chain only. No child matrix, leaf Role Lens or decision was touched; the parent row now restates what the children already grant.

items.summary: Two files restated the ledger's placement of 08.03.01/08.03.02 as § MUST (195); the ledger files both under § SHOULD (285). Confirmed against the ledger directly: section boundaries at lines 17 / 217 / 507 / 713, domain-08 MUST rows at 80-83 (08.05.01, 08.05.02, 08.05.04, 08.07 — each Must *conditional on the domain shipping*), and the 08.03.01 row at 291 carrying verbatim the rationale quoted in the drifted text ('The one part of domain 08 with proven willingness to pay … Crucially it is latency-TOLERANT'). The quote was genuine; only the bucket label attached to it had drifted. The bucket was incidental to what Q-03 actually resolves — that the ledger files these features under the domain-08 path rather than moving them to Services (05) or Projects (07) — so the resolution stands unchanged and only the label is corrected, in both the inline sentence and the Deferred-To column of each Q-03 row. The corrected prose is grounded in this shard's own domain index Q-03 ('Everything except Overdub Mode needs media infrastructure that meta/constraints.md does not have') and ledger row 83 ('the only feature that runs on the locked stack'); no priority was invented and the ledger was not edited.

crossDomainNotes: moscow-ledger.md is outside this shard and was read as canonical only — not modified. The § MUST (195) label was pasted into two files here alongside a rationale copied verbatim from a SHOULD row, which suggests a copy-paste sweep rather than a one-off; other shards citing 'moscow-ledger.md § **MUST (195)**' should be checked against the ledger's actual section boundaries (MUST 17-216, SHOULD 217-506, COULD 507-712, WONT 713+).

The parent-Role-Matrix max-roll-up convention is real and consistent across this domain but is written down nowhere — no file in ideation/ states it. Other domains' parent matrices cannot be audited against it without an owner ratifying it as the convention.
